title: Frequency Allocation Dataset — Comprehensive Fact-Check Report
scope: 280-1100 MHz across 9 countries (FR, US, UK, CN, DE, RU, ES, IT, CH)
methodology: Multi-agent expert regulatory review using ITU Radio Regulations, FCC 47 CFR, CEPT ECC Decisions, ETSI standards, ICAO Annex 10, 3GPP specifications, and national regulators (ANFR, Ofcom, BNetzA, BAKOM, CNMC, AGCOM, MIIT, GRFC).
key_corrections_applied: AEHF replaced with MUOS in US UHF MILSATCOM entries
BeiDou/GLONASS at 399.9 MHz corrected (both L-band only)
UK 700 MHz: Vodafone replaced with O2/VMO2 (auction winner)
FR 700 MHz: Free/Bouygues 2x5/2x10 allocations swapped back to correct
ECC Decision (14)02 replaced with (15)01 for 700 MHz duplex gap
FR Gazpar gas meters: noted as 169 MHz VHF, not 868 MHz
ITU footnote 5.328A corrected to 5.328B for 1090 MHz protection
DME Y-mode pulse spacing corrected: 30 µs → 36 µs (ICAO Annex 10)
FR 694-700 MHz guard band extended to 694-703 MHz (ECC/DEC/(15)01)
Cospas-Sarsat 406 MHz: added ITU RR 5.266 footnote
EU TPMS mandate: added Nov 2012 deadline (was Nov 2014 only)
sources_consulted: ICAO Annex 10 Vol I (Aeronautical Radio Navigation)
ANFR TNRBF, Ofcom UKPFA, BNetzA Frequenzplan, BAKOM Frequenzzuweisungsplan
CNMC CNAF (Spain), AGCOM PNRF (Italy), MIIT (China), GRFC (Russia)
limitations: Performed via expert regulatory knowledge (training data) — not live source verification
Very recent regulatory changes (2025+) may not be reflected
Some country-specific operator details (e.g., exact MHz allocations to specific carriers) need live ARCEP/Ofcom/BNetzA registry confirmation
Modulation specifics for proprietary systems (military, China PDT) cannot be independently verified from public sources
